scope: WiKirby prose/caption cross-check of native-positive rooms. Summaries are paraphrases, not map-image inspection or controller acceptance. Native coordinates establish presence when prose omits the block class. F7 environmental presence is not proof of visually reinforced metal; the initial reinforced label was overbroad.

rooms.context_and_next_check: Lower tunnel to Battle Notes is blocked by a Heave-Ho Block. Inspect its falling path and the F7 environmental tiles rather than assigning a copy-ability gate.
Horizontal log/barrel hall; Mirra protects the Carrot Castle door. Article does not name F7 environmental tiles; determine which environmental barrier uses them.
Wooden platforms above a pit, with two left exits and a hidden Star Block door. Article does not identify F7 environmental tiles or their function.
Coastal path divides into upper and lower approaches to Room 5. Article does not identify the F7 environmental tile mechanism.

Upper and Mini routes converge toward Goal 1; the Ocean Spray Paint route uses a Heave-Ho Block and Mini passage. Match F7 environmental coordinates to the relevant mechanism; do not equate these with ordinary metal.
Mixed Star/metal barriers between grassy platforms, with local Flamers. Multiple entrances and upper-right exits require separate source and approach analysis.
Stone slope, pegged chest barrier, and underwater channel. Article does not call out F7 environmental metal; match the native cluster to the environmental mechanism.
Batafire chamber has a metal-blocked Energy Drink chest to its right. Burning from the defeated mid-boss is a vanilla candidate; the Goal door is a separate target.

Article caption identifies a metal barrier; most doors are accessible but Chest-room access needs an outside ability. Aerial Hammer cleared the isolated native floor plug; source access and other clearance still need validation.
Metal barricade protects a 1-Up chest in the icy tunnel. Article calls for an outside ability; validate carried equipment and contact from each approach.
Right-hand metal branch leads to a 1-Up chest; other branches include a rope puzzle and three exits. Destructive choices can block other compartments.
Left side passage from the tower leads to a metal-blocked 1-Up chest. Keep this distinct from the Grape Spray Paint tower and main Warp route.
Two entrances supply Flamer or Rocky before paths merge. Metal protects a 1-Up along the tunnel; a second 1-Up beyond the exit has different hazards.
Article describes ruin chambers and Minny access to the Warp route, but does not name the metal tiles. Both native classes occur; map them to compartments before inferring a gate.
Entry from Room 15 leads through Phan Phan; entry from Room 16 bypasses that fight. Article does not name metal; native presence must not become a mandatory boss/Throw rule.
Chest 2 return enters the upper path; an ability from that chest room can break a metal barrier for a 1-Up. Entry direction and source accessibility matter.
Side passage behind metal and spikes contains a 1-Up. Another 1-Up triggers Heavy Knights and a Bomb Block response. Separate ordinary and F7 environmental clusters.
Path continues right after Master Hand, past barriers and oversized enemies. Article does not explicitly label metal; Smash and Giant Rocky are vanilla candidates, not proven access rules.

Lower of two passages splits again; the lower branch has metal, spikes, Flamers, and a Maxim Tomato before Chest 3. Upper passage leads to Warp. Do not use a Flamer behind the barrier to justify entry.
Open airborne route includes a Maxim Tomato behind metal. Local UFO is a vanilla candidate; charged shot position and barrier overlap still need verification.
Open canyon with a Bomb Block 1-Up and Fuse Cannon near exits. Article does not name ordinary metal; inspect its native coordinates against those mechanisms.
Upper peg opens the 1-Up chamber; UFO can appear inside and break its right-hand metal exit. That internal source cannot justify entering the chamber from outside.
Different Room 3 doors enter different compartments. Food and a battery sit between metal sets near the Rainbow Route door; audit optional pickup access separately from exits.
Timed gate, Sword Knight, and Bomb Block sequence leads to Sapphire paint. Native F7 environmental tiles belong in that environmental-state audit, not the ordinary-metal ability list.
Flooded tunnels split by metal into two channels, also connected at a bottomless pit. Air-pocket drink and left/right routes need water-state and entry-specific analysis.
Tunnel maze with a Bomb Block barrier protecting the area map, then a stone-barrier chamber before the Goal door. Article does not name F7 environmental metal explicitly.
Cannons launch through a spike section toward metal; ladders above reach Room 28. Return Bomb Block changes access. Cannon-based breaking must be considered independently of copy abilities.
Metal blocks a Gordo side chamber; Bomb Block order can contain or release the Gordos. Main exits, timed gate, and occasional UFO are separate route/source questions.
Short paired spike tunnels permit different passage by travel direction. Article does not identify F7 environmental blocks; keep directional environmental barriers distinct.
Right-side metal passage protects Beginning Notes. Article calls for an imported ability or Mix; random/lucky Mix is not a guaranteed source witness.
Two-way maze, Gordo-guarded pickups, Giant Rockies, and a shortcut. Article does not identify F7 environmental tiles or imply ordinary Stone can remove them.
Downward cave leads to a Bomb Block-opened water current; a second bomb barrier protects a 1-Up. Reinforced positions need matching to those environmental changes.
Master Hand supplies Smash before the metal-blocked Maxim Tomato chest. Goal door remains a separate target; shuffled sources must be evaluated from actual policy.
Entry direction and Bomb Block barriers determine usable exits. Reinforced tiles must be evaluated with destructive room state rather than a generic ability check.
Compartment maze restricts Room 8 and Chest 1 access from Room 2, with a peg alternative for the chest. Native F7 environmental tiles need mechanism-level reconciliation.
Metal guards a Maxim Tomato and shortcut toward Room 3; article calls for an outside ability. Both native classes occur and must not be conflated.
Lower metal branch protects ham; upper cannon route leads through Master Hand to Room 19. Local Flamers and later Smash are candidates only from reachable compartments.

Descending ruined hall and crumbling bridge lead past a released Gordo. A Bomb Block releases water into the final chamber and the door to Room 3. Match the native F7 coordinates separately; Bomb-chain participation is not implied by F7 presence.

Rightward cannon branch has a 1-Up below ordinary metal; article describes two-Sparky Mix yielding Missile. Other cannon branches serve Mini, Phan Phan, and the exit. Verify source policy and keep F7 environmental tiles separate.

Enemy-free branching cannon sequence: upper path collects battery/tomato, lower path cherry/1-Up, both toward Room 12. Large F7 environmental count is environmental terrain, not evidence of 220 separate ability gates.
Metal barrier protects a tomato on the way toward Bonkers; alternate return from Room 15 has Flamers. Do not use later Hammer to justify an earlier inaccessible barrier.
Upper roof path is metal-blocked; lower path loops to Room 14 to obtain Burning. Returning opens access toward the sparerib chest and Warp door.
Correct entry is required to descend; Bomb Block activates a sparking machine and opens the path, then a lever opens Room 12. Reinforced tiles require environmental-state review.

Underwater Bomb Block barrier changes walls to spikes; dry section has Sparky and cannons. The final cannon accesses optional goodies, then a current leads to Chest 2. Article does not explicitly identify the metal class.
